messages:
Priya CSM: Quick weekly pulse for Aurum — need a short summary of p95/p99 by route and model, split streaming vs non-streaming. Goal: check onboarding risk and whether we should enable higher burst capacity or adjust routing.
Jared SE: pulling raw numbers now, will paste a compact table.
Maya CS: FYI customer reported a few slow tails yesterday, suspected non-streamed long responses on large prompts.
Jared SE: pasted from telemetry:```
route: /generate (model: redwood-v2)  p95: streaming=220ms  non-stream=610ms  p99: streaming=610ms  non-stream=1.45s
route: /chat (model: redwood-v2-chat) p95: streaming=180ms  non-stream=420ms  p99: streaming=480ms  non-stream=980ms
route: /embed (model: embed-xl) p95: streaming=N/A  non-stream=120ms  p99=non-stream=330ms
```
Priya CSM: Nice. Can you also include error-rate delta and spend note? Need to signal any renewal risk.
Jared SE: error rate spike: +0.2% overall last 24h, concentrated on /generate nonstream — mostly 5xx from OOM on pinned instance (logs point to kvcache pressure).
Maya CS: Customer usage trend: steady weekly growth +12% WAU, but 95% of calls are non-streamed. They're using our SDK default which opts non-stream for historic reasons.
Tim Eng: infra-bot just alerted about a memory pressure throttling event at 06:12 UTC. infra-bot: "[ALERT] instance-gn4: mem_pressure=true, evicting kvcache entries, latency tail increasing"
Priya CSM: Actionables: 1) Recommend switching heavy prompt routes to streaming for Aurum; 2) Engage SE to propose a small routing tweak or burst capacity during peak; 3) Send short enablement note to Aurum engineering on streaming SDK usage. Anyone object?
Jared SE: I'll draft the routing proposal — suggest canary 10% streaming-first for /generate, and add prefix caching on their most common prompts.
Maya CS: I'll coordinate the customer enablement convo and note potential renewal flag if tails persist into next week's check.
Tim Eng: I'll open infra ticket to increase kvcache reservation for their dedicated pool temporarily and monitor p99 for 2 hours.
Priya CSM: Great. Putting this into the weekly recap doc and tagging @Aurum team. Will follow up with a short one-pager on streaming benefits. :thumbsup:
